title: Leicester HM Land Registry INSPIRE local topology audit

source.request: Anonymous GET through the site ordinary cookie flow; no account, API key, or property-specific input.
source.fieldsNotReadOrRetained: All other property attributes and their values were left unread by the audit; no owner/address data were retained.

method.geometrySelection: Select complete source geometries that intersect the stated 1 km square; do not clip to the square.
method.geometryValidation: Shapely/GEOS validity check on each complete native geometry.
method.pairCheck: STRtree candidate pairs on complete source geometries; each unordered pair tested once with exact topological equality and intersection area.
method.scope: No repair, simplification, clipping, deduplication, or clean-subset selection; counts describe all local candidates.

reproducedPriorWindow.description: This reproduces the bounds supplied in the earlier Leicester review and returns its 1,662-feature count.

independentLocalProjTransform.coordinateOperation: PROJ 9.8.1 EPSG:4326 to EPSG:27700 best available operation; axis-ordered geographic input latitude, longitude.

window.reconciliation: The supplied prior-window center is (459267.36184217216, 304042.92059304944), while the installed PROJ transformation yields (459266.854724551, 304040.890552977), approximately 0.51 m west and 2.03 m south of the supplied center. The resulting candidate counts differ by one; both windows produce the same validity, duplicate, overlap-pair, and total-overlap results. The PROJ operation reports 1 m accuracy, so sub-meter exactness is not asserted.

conflicts.duplicateClusterNote: The six equal-geometry pairs form a four-feature duplicate cluster with INSPIREIDs 29707254, 29707255, 29707256, and 29707257; each polygon area is approximately 766.505245 m2.
conflicts.overlapInterpretation: Pairwise intersection areas are summed per pair and therefore may count the same shared area more than once when three or more polygons overlap.

sourceLimit: HM Land Registry describes INSPIRE index polygons as indicative extents of registered freehold property, not authoritative legal boundaries or a complete representation of all land parcels.
